title: CFS Large Development-Land Acquisition Case Study Underwriting Input Register
status: Evidence validation and assumption review only
scope: Prepare the existing shortlist for future financial underwriting without changing CASE-1 conclusions, creating final calculations, or producing a final workbook.

funnel_verification.data_vintage: CFS cloud-safe local stage validated against Azure cfs_cloud during AZ-1B
funnel_verification.current_treatment: Preserve original screening revision unless user approves a new screen.
criteria: Start with all CFS cloud-safe public parcel rows with a parcel identifier.
Filter to parcels with gross acreage greater than or equal to 100 acres.
Require usable CFS planning, transportation, and Investment evidence.
Initial screen requires transportation evidence, environmental band other than High Verification Need, and sewer-proximity proxy of Adjacent, Near, or Moderate.
Manual review uses the 100-point CASE-1 analyst screen and includes the required active parcel without forcing rank.

ask_cfs_validation_prompts.prompt: How was the developable-area estimate calculated?
ask_cfs_validation_prompts.expected_guardrail: Describe unioned flood/wetland constraints plus open-space/stormwater assumption; do not double-count overlaps.

ask_cfs_validation_prompts.prompt: Which underwriting assumptions still need review?
ask_cfs_validation_prompts.expected_guardrail: List missing inputs without inventing financial numbers.

ask_cfs_validation_prompts.prompt: Which assumptions are likely to have the largest effect?
ask_cfs_validation_prompts.expected_guardrail: Identify acreage, density, value, infrastructure cost, utilities, timeline, contingency, and margin as sensitivities without calculating outputs.

ask_cfs_validation_prompts.prompt: What professional estimates are still required?
ask_cfs_validation_prompts.expected_guardrail: Call out civil, utility, access, title, entitlement, environmental field, geotechnical, and market/value reviews.
